# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting AgentVela privately via
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/redwolf2019/AgentVela/security/advisories/new).
Please do not disclose them in public issues or pull requests until maintainers have had a
reasonable opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for trust boundaries, intended behavior, and threat-model scope.
